items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.content: We require 24-hour notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows may be charged 50% of the service price.

items.title: Arrival Time
items.content: Please arrive 10-15 minutes before your appointment to relax and complete any necessary forms. Late arrivals may result in shortened treatment time.

items.title: Gift Certificates
items.content: Gift certificates are available in any amount and never expire. Purchase online or in person.

items.title: Gratuity
items.content: Gratuity is not included in our service prices. If you'd like to acknowledge exceptional service, tips are always appreciated.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: We provide robes and slippers for your comfort. For massage, you'll undress to your comfort level and be professionally draped throughout.

items.question: Can I request a specific therapist?
items.answer: Absolutely! When booking, you can request your preferred therapist. We recommend booking in advance for popular team members.

items.question: Do you accommodate special needs?
items.answer: Yes, please let us know about any health conditions, injuries, or preferences when booking so we can customize your experience.
